component.name: Playser
component.summary: Play DVDs, Blu-rays and 4K UHD discs from the couch

description.p: Playser is a disc player for the TV, made for SteamOS Game Mode and the controller in your hand. Put in a DVD, Blu-ray or 4K UHD disc: Playser finds the main feature, shows the disc's title and art, and plays it with its menus, in HDR, with surround sound.

ul.li: DVD and Blu-ray menus, including Java (BD-J) menus
Blu-ray 3D on XR glasses such as VITURE, in full side-by-side
Surround sound decoded, or sent to your receiver as-is (Dolby Digital, TrueHD, DTS-HD Master Audio)
Disc titles, episode lists and art from TheDiscDB, with Play all for TV discs
Picks up where you left off
Audio and subtitle choice from the controller
Works with Steam Input and any common gamepad

description.p: Blu-ray and 4K UHD discs need MakeMKV, which you buy separately; DVDs play without it. 4K UHD also needs a drive that MakeMKV can read UHD discs with (LibreDrive).

Blu-ray 3D on XR glasses (VITURE): both eyes decoded, followed live as the glasses switch between 2D and 3D, with the menus and controls shown to each eye and sound through the glasses. Disc menus that start without video now show.
First release: DVD and Blu-ray menus, 4K UHD with HDR, audio passthrough, disc titles and episodes from TheDiscDB.
